caption:
See how deterministic taxonomy scoring weights required terms double.

JobRez uses a deterministic role match engine. It evaluates your tailored resume branch against the target posting using a curated technology taxonomy with aliases and whole-word matching.

Required terms are weighted double and preferred terms once. There is no cloud AI and no external verification involved.

Learn more at https://jobrez.com.
